description: Open a new tab in the user's own Chrome, with their logins, and optionally load a URL. The tab opens in the background inside this session's tab group: Chrome is not brought to the front and the user's tabs are untouched, so they can keep working. Returns the tabId the other browser tools need.

profile.description: Chrome profile to open the tab in, by its name or id from browser_list_profiles. Only needed when the user has Tabhand in several profiles. Your later tabs open there too.

url.description: Page to load, e.g. https://example.com. Omit for a blank tab.

name: browser_open_tab
